Context: 1. Eligibility

## 1. Eligibility  
1. Any employee with one year of continuous service on the date of journey performed by him/his family is eligible.  
Example.An official appointed on 31-12-2022 will be eligible for the two-year block 2024-2025, but those appointed on or after 1-1-2025, will not be eligible for that block. - Rule 2.
